bhajan.title: Akhanda Jyothi Jalao Sai Man Mandir Mey

discourse.excerpt: All these festivals have a profound meaning and purpose. But no earnest effort is made to understand their inner meaning and deeper objectives.
discourse.theme: Festivals are not mere holidays — they celebrate Avatars and saints and mark the destruction of evil forces.
discourse.title: Inner Significance Of Festivals

reflection: Swami reminds us that our festivals carry a profound meaning and purpose — they celebrate the lives of Avatars and saints and mark the destruction of evil forces. The next time you light a lamp or gather for a festival, pause and ask: what inner victory does this mark in my own life? That small reflection turns ritual into remembrance. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 21, 9 Nov 1988)
seva_nudge: Bring festival light to someone else: visit an elderly neighbour or a lonely friend and share sweets — or simply your time.
